helpers_sql:
-- Install once on PostgreSQL in a schema controlled by the application owner.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fdd;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.try_double(value text)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN trim(value)::double precision;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN RETURN NULL;
END;
$$;

-- Sensor sweep assessability (twin of pandas sensor_sweep_catalog). Long-form inputs are SI only:
-- each sample is assessed only when its declared unit matches the role's SI quantity. Any other
-- unit, or none, masks that sample; nothing is converted or guessed here.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.norm_unit(value text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(btrim(value), ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'));
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('air_handling_unit_discharge_air_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature_setpoint', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature',
      'cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature', 'cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature', 'zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint', 'return_condenser_water_temperature',
      'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature', 'heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature', 'zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint',
      'return_hot_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'preheat_heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature_setpoint',
      'terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature', 'terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature', 'weather_service_air_dew_point_temperature', 'weather_service_air_temperature', 'weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature_setpoint', 'zone_air_temperature')
      THEN 'absolute_temperature'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'weather_service_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity')
      THEN 'relative_humidity'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta_setpoint', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_static_pressure_setpoint') THEN 'air_pressure'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate_minimum', 'terminal_unit_discharge_air_total_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate_setpoint', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate') THEN 'volume_flow'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_electric_power', 'electric_power') THEN 'power'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('electric_energy') THEN 'energy'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_electric_current') THEN 'electric_current'
    WHEN btrim(role) = 'zone_air_co2' THEN 'concentration'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chilled_water_reset_request_count', 'hot_water_reset_request_count', 'discharge_air_static_pressure_reset_request_count') THEN 'count'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit text, quantity text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN unit IS NULL OR btrim(unit) = '' THEN false
    WHEN quantity = 'absolute_temperature' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('c', 'degc', 'celsius')
    WHEN quantity = 'relative_humidity' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pct', 'percent', 'percent0100', 'rh', 'percentrelativehumidity', 'percentrh')
      OR position('%' IN unit) > 0
    WHEN quantity = 'air_pressure' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pa', 'pascal')
    WHEN quantity = 'volume_flow' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('ls', 'lpersec', 'lsec')
    WHEN quantity = 'power' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kw'
    WHEN quantity = 'energy' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kwh'
    WHEN quantity = 'electric_current' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'a'
    WHEN quantity = 'concentration' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'ppm'
    WHEN quantity = 'count' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'count'
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) = '' THEN false
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%sp' THEN true
    WHEN position('setpoint' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('status' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%cmd' THEN true
    WHEN position('command' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'occmode' THEN true
    WHEN position('occupied' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('occupancy' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'loopenabled' THEN true
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role text, unit text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role) THEN false
    ELSE fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit, fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role))
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.mask_sweep_val(role text, unit text, val double precision)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE WHEN fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role, unit) THEN val ELSE NULL END;
$$;

-- DuckDB twins of postgres/postgres_helpers.sql (#1645): the fdd.* helpers as SQL macros, SI units only.
-- The DuckDB engine (nf-app/hooks/lib/engines.js, kind "duckdb") installs them once per warm instance and then runs
-- the Postgres rule pack unchanged. Keep each macro equal to its Postgres function; nf-app/tests/duckdb-engine.test.mjs
-- checks them against PGlite on the same inputs.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fdd;

-- Postgres trim(value)::double precision, NULL for invalid or out-of-range text.
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO fdd.try_double(value) AS
  CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)), '[+-]?([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?')
         AND isfinite(TRY_CAST(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE))
       THEN TRY_CAST(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE)
       WHEN regexp_full_match(lower(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR))), '[+-]?(inf|infinity|nan)')
       THEN TRY_CAST(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE)
       ELSE NULL END;

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO fdd.norm_unit(value) AS
  lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)), ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'));

    WHEN trim(role) IN ('air_handling_unit_discharge_air_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature_setpoint', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature',
      'cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature', 'cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature', 'zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint', 'return_condenser_water_temperature',

      THEN 'absolute_temperature'
    WHEN trim(role) IN ('mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'weather_service_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity')
      THEN 'relative_humidity'

    WHEN trim(role) IN ('chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate_minimum', 'terminal_unit_discharge_air_total_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate_setpoint', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate') THEN 'volume_flow'

    WHEN trim(role) IN ('chiller_electric_current') THEN 'electric_current'

    WHEN trim(role) IN ('chilled_water_reset_request_count', 'hot_water_reset_request_count', 'discharge_air_static_pressure_reset_request_count') THEN 'count'

    WHEN quantity = 'power' THEN fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kw'

    WHEN quantity = 'electric_current' THEN fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'a'

CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role) AS
  CASE
    WHEN trim(role) = '' THEN false

    WHEN position('setpoint' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true

-- Postgres to_char, only the one form the rules use: UTIL-MONTHLY's UTC billing month (ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM').
-- Any other format fails loudly instead of returning a wrong key.
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO to_char(ts, fmt) AS
  CASE WHEN fmt = 'YYYY-MM' THEN strftime(ts, '%Y-%m') ELSE error('to_char: only the YYYY-MM format is supported') END;

FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while supply_fan_command > 0.5.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    supply_fan_command AS supply_fan_command,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    supply_fan_command,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

VAV-1.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occupancy_status is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occupancy_status from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occupancy_status exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference supply_fan_command here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack supply_fan_command; the rule is then → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_air_temperature,
    occupancy_status,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature < 21.111111111 OR zone_air_temperature > 23.888888889 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5
       AND occupancy_status IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- zone_comfort_pct.sql
-- Comfort is the share of eligible elapsed time inside the band, not a row count.
-- Band placeholders ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI and history zone_air_temperature are SI °C (metric pack).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_air_temperature >= 20 AND zone_air_temperature <= 24.444444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS comfort_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): outdoor_air_intake_temperature and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment weather_service_air_temperature (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, weather_service_air_temperature AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, weather_service_air_temperature AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.outdoor_air_intake_temperature,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS double precision) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > 1500
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(outdoor_air_intake_temperature - ref_oa_t) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 1
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
       AND COALESCE(LAG(assessable) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), false)
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN assessable AND raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sat_high_fault.sql — FC13 SAT above SP at full cooling + confirm (matches cookbook fc13)
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    discharge_air_temperature,
    discharge_air_temperature_setpoint,
    COALESCE(cooling_valve_position_command, 0.0) AS cooling_valve_position_command,
    COALESCE(outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command, 0.0) AS outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command,
    supply_fan_command,
    supply_fan_operating_status,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
       AND cooling_valve_position_command > 90
       AND discharge_air_temperature > discharge_air_temperature_setpoint + 0.638888889
       AND (outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command <= 5 OR outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command > 90)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

  SELECT equipment_id,

  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')

  FROM sample_times

  FROM proof_stream

  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,

    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized

),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (

    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature')
),

  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((1 < 0.5 OR (energized = 1 AND coverage_pct >= 5)) AND ((sensor_role = 'outdoor_air_intake_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 20.0 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'mixed_air_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 13.888889 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'zone_air_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 6.666667 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'return_air_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 6.666667 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'discharge_air_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 22.222222 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'supply_chilled_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'return_chilled_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'supply_hot_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 33.333333 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'return_hot_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 33.333333 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 25.0 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'discharge_air_static_pressure' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 497.68 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'supply_condenser_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'return_condenser_water_temperature' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 AND equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

-- SV-STALE (#1673): missing data. A sensor series is stale while it has no valid sample for longer than
-- STALE_AFTER_HOURS. This rule has no value test (a stuck value that is still polled is SV-FLATLINE) and no
-- run-proof gate (data monitoring does not depend on the motor).
--
-- Expected series: `sweep_series` lists every bound series the caller fetched successfully, with its requested
-- window [window_start, window_end). A bound series with no sample at all is therefore assessed (it faults for
-- the whole window beyond STALE_AFTER_HOURS). A series the caller could not fetch is not listed and is not
-- assessed. Callers that do not fill `sweep_series` get the series present in `sensor_history`, over the
-- equipment's observed window (first to last timestamp in history and sensor_history).
--
-- Per series, the window start, every valid sample and the window end split the window into intervals. An
-- interval longer than STALE_AFTER_SECONDS contributes (interval - STALE_AFTER_SECONDS) of fault time, starting
-- STALE_AFTER_SECONDS after its first point. covered_hours is the whole window.
WITH eq_window AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, MIN(epoch_seconds) AS start_epoch, MAX(epoch_seconds) AS end_epoch
  FROM (
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM history
    UNION ALL
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM sensor_history
    WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  ) observed
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
declared AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_start)) AS start_epoch, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_end)) AS end_epoch
  FROM sweep_series
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
observed_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
expected AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch, end_epoch FROM declared
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.equipment_id, o.series_id, o.sensor_role, w.start_epoch, w.end_epoch
  FROM observed_series o
  JOIN eq_window w ON w.equipment_id = o.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN declared d ON d.equipment_id = o.equipment_id AND d.series_id = o.series_id
  WHERE d.series_id IS NULL
),
points AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM expected e
  JOIN sensor_history s ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND s.series_id = e.series_id
  WHERE fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) >= e.start_epoch
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) <= e.end_epoch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, end_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
),
steps AS (
  SELECT points.*,
    LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS next_epoch
  FROM points
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds, next_epoch - epoch_seconds AS dt_seconds
  FROM steps
  WHERE next_epoch IS NOT NULL AND next_epoch > epoch_seconds
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch, 0 AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800 THEN 1800 ELSE dt_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch, 1 AS confirmed,
    dt_seconds - 1800 AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  WHERE dt_seconds > 1800
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN scored ON scored.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND scored.series_id = e.series_id
ORDER BY e.equipment_id, e.series_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Sensor-series input and output are keyed by the bound point UUID, not the role.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > (3.333333 * 100 / 100.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 AND energized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,

base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL

flagged AS (

),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,

  FROM base

streaks AS (

    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0

      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- pid_hunt_1.sql — Suspected control-output hunting (rolling 1h metrics)
-- Matches pandas hunting_fault_mask: TV / span / cycles / reversals over
-- WINDOW_HOURS. The detection window is still a row frame (WINDOW_ROWS).
-- Fault hours integrate eligible forward deltas and do not add a phantom
-- interval after the last sample. 12 / 11
-- are derived from WINDOW_HOURS + POLL_SECONDS (literal ROWS bounds).
-- Control outputs arrive as PERCENT 0-100 (the ingest converts a fraction source once). Span, deadband
-- and variation thresholds are percent points; do not scale the column again.
-- exactly here, once, because the *_PCT parameters (span, deadband, total variation) are percent points.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(operating_status) AS operating_status
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command
      WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        cooling_valve_position_command
      WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        heating_valve_position_command
      WHEN damper_position IS NOT NULL THEN
        damper_position
      ELSE NULL
    END AS out_pct,
    LAG(
      CASE
        WHEN outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command
        WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          cooling_valve_position_command
        WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          heating_valve_position_command
        WHEN damper_position IS NOT NULL THEN
          damper_position
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_out,
    COALESCE(operating_mode_status, 1.0) AS loop_on,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_out IS NULL OR out_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(out_pct - prev_out) >= 1 THEN out_pct - prev_out
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS sig_delta
  FROM h
),
steps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(sig_delta)
    END AS abs_step,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL OR sig_delta = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sig_delta * LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) < 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS reversal_event
  FROM deltas
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    out_pct,
    fan_on,
    loop_on,
    COUNT(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS n_samples,
    SUM(abs_step) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS tv,
    MAX(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - MIN(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS span,
    SUM(reversal_event) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS reversals
  FROM steps
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN loop_on IS NOT NULL AND loop_on <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN out_pct IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN n_samples < CAST(CEIL(12 * 80 / 100.0) AS INT) THEN 0
      WHEN span < 20 THEN 0
      WHEN tv < 500 THEN 0
      WHEN span <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (tv / (2.0 * NULLIF(span, 0))) < 2.5 THEN 0
      WHEN reversals < 4 THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM win
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc4_os_hunting.sql — PID hunting (operating-state oscillation), GL36 fault 4
-- ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the clock hour: count how many times the AHU *enters* each
-- operating state within the hour and flag the whole hour when any state is
-- entered more than DELTA_OS_MAX times.
-- Operating states: 1 = min OA / heating, 2 = economizer, 3 = mechanical cooling
-- (0 = fan off, not counted).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(operating_status) AS operating_status
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command AS oa_d,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE supply_fan_command
    END AS fan,
    CASE

  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1642: the weather sidecar is joined as-of, per variable: the latest web sample at or before the history row, used for at
-- most WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin; the OAT-METEO join and pandas weather_on_grid). An exact timestamp
-- join left 2 of 3 rows without weather on a 5-min grid with 15-min weather, and those rows broke confirmation.
wx_web_oa_t AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc AS ref_ts, ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(weather_service_air_temperature) AS ref_val
    FROM weather
    WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY timestamp_utc
  ) wx_web_oa_t_points
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(h.weather_service_air_temperature, wx_web_oa_t.ref_val) AS weather_service_air_temperature,
    h.outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command AS oa_d,
    h.supply_fan_command,
    h.supply_fan_operating_status,
    CASE
      WHEN h.supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN wx_web_oa_t
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts
   AND (wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts)
   AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts)) <= 1500
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN weather_service_air_temperature IS NULL OR oa_d IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN weather_service_air_temperature < -3.888889 AND oa_d > 25 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

    CASE WHEN h.compressor_operating_status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.compressor_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN h.chiller_operating_status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c2,

-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav3_excessive_reheat.sql — Excessive reheat during warm weather
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    outdoor_air_intake_temperature, discharge_air_volume_flow_rate,
    terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command AS rh,
    supply_fan_command,
    supply_fan_operating_status,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR rh IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(discharge_air_volume_flow_rate, 0) > 11.798675
       AND outdoor_air_intake_temperature > 25.555555556 AND rh > 52 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    supply_chilled_water_temperature, supply_chilled_water_temperature_setpoint,
    chilled_water_pump_command AS pump,
    pump_operating_status, chiller_operating_status, chilled_water_volume_flow_rate
  FROM history
),
proof AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS proof_on
  FROM h
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on IS NULL OR proof_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN supply_chilled_water_temperature IS NULL OR supply_chilled_water_temperature_setpoint IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(supply_chilled_water_temperature - supply_chilled_water_temperature_setpoint) > 1.222222 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM proof
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

-- sched1_unoccupied_runtime.sql — Excess / wasted unoccupied runtime
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_air_temperature and the ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI comfort band are °C.
-- Pandas sched1: unoccupied & fan_on; when zone_air_temperature mapped, also require comfort band
-- (zone already satisfied → optimal-start / bad schedule signal).
-- When zone_air_temperature is absent from history, the runner injects NULL zone_air_temperature (optional role)
-- so behavior matches pandas “no zone → base only”.
-- Portable occupancy: literal 'unoccupied' OR numeric/boolean falsey (0 / 0.0 / false).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
        CAST(CASE
          WHEN occupancy_status IS NULL OR supply_fan_operating_status IS NULL THEN 0
          WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.5
            AND (
              LOWER(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IN
                ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
              OR (
                fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
                AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
              )
            )
            AND (
              zone_air_temperature IS NULL
              OR (zone_air_temperature >= 21.111111 AND zone_air_temperature <= 23.888889)
            )
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
