-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sched247_always_on.sql — Always-on fan or pump runtime (#1670)
-- ALWAYS_ON_PCT is a percent of proven run time (95 means 95%).
--
-- Proof per sample: the first non-NULL status (fan, pump, chw pump, chiller, compressor, chiller current) wins over
-- the commands (tower fan, fan, chw pump); run when > 0.05 (sql/fdd/operating_status.json threshold); a sample with
-- neither is UNKNOWN (never a proven OFF). Each sample holds forward to the next one; a hold longer than
-- MAX_GAP_HOURS, and the last sample, hold nothing.
--
-- Durations (hours): window = first..last history row of the equipment (the observed window);
-- proven_on / proven_off = held time with known proof; unknown = window - proven_on - proven_off.
-- Completeness: the verdict needs proven time >= 0.9 * max(window, 24 h). "Always on" is judged on the
-- observed window but never on less than one day of proof. Otherwise assessment = 'insufficient_proof'
-- (or 'no_proof' when nothing is known) and fault_hours / fault_pct are NULL.
-- Qualifier: proven_on / (proven_on + proven_off) >= ALWAYS_ON_PCT (time-weighted). Fault time is the
-- confirmed proven-ON time (CONFIRM_SECONDS streaks) of a qualifying equipment.
WITH proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN compressor_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN compressor_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_electric_current IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_electric_current > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN cooling_tower_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN cooling_tower_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS INT) AS on_bit
  FROM history
),
stepped AS (
  SELECT
    proof.*,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM proof
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) OR on_bit IS NULL
      THEN 0.0 ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gap_after
  FROM stepped
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp_utc) - MIN(timestamp_utc))) AS window_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS on_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 0 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS off_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
verdict AS (
  SELECT
    summary.*,
    CASE
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds <= 0.0 THEN 'no_proof'
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds < 0.9 * (CASE WHEN window_seconds > 86400.0 THEN window_seconds ELSE 86400.0 END)
        THEN 'insufficient_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM summary
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.held_seconds,
    h.gap_after,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
       AND 100.0 * v.on_seconds / (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) >= 95
       AND h.on_bit = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM held h
  JOIN verdict v ON v.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM base
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  v.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed' THEN t.fault_seconds / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
    THEN 100.0 * t.fault_seconds / NULLIF(v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds, 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  v.window_seconds / 3600.0 AS window_hours,
  v.on_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_on_hours,
  v.off_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_off_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds > 0.0
    THEN (v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS unknown_hours,
  v.assessment
FROM verdict v
JOIN (
  SELECT equipment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_seconds
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) t ON t.equipment_id = v.equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-SENSOR-NULL — own zone setpoint exists while a mapped zone sensor is predominantly null.
-- The runner rewrites this file to zero hours when zone_air_temperature is absent from history.
-- Null time and eligible time are eligible forward deltas. A long gap is unknown.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_air_temperature,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_air_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS eligible_seconds,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN zone_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NULL THEN held_seconds
      ELSE 0.0
    END) AS null_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 90
    THEN null_seconds / 3600.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  eligible_seconds / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 90
    THEN 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_pct
FROM coverage;

      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
), base AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE WHEN fan_on = 1 AND zone_air_co2 IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_co2 > 1000 AND zone_air_co2 >= 300.0 AND dcmd IS NOT NULL AND dcmd < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM normalized
), elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)

      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
), grouped AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-DEADBAND — pass-through FCU setpoints remain site-native Celsius.
-- Duration is the eligible forward delta, not a row count times poll.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
     AND zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint - zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
     AND zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint - zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

FCU-MODE-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-MODE-CYCLE — cumulative heat/cool mode transitions in the analysis window.
-- Hours are eligible forward deltas after the change count reaches MODE_CHANGES.
-- #1642: each sample holds the time to the NEXT sample of any mode (forward sample-and-hold); the change count runs
-- over the heating / cooling samples only. An idle sample is never fault time, and an active sample no longer holds
-- the idle stretch after it (it used to own the gap to the next active sample), as pandas fcu_mode_cycle.
WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL AND cooling_valve_position_command > 10 THEN -1
      WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL AND heating_valve_position_command > 10 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM modes
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed
  FROM held
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;

UTIL-MONTHLY.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_monthly_fault.sql — BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh; UTIL_PCT_ERR is a percent of utility kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    electric_energy,
    electric_power,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL OR electric_power IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timestamp_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_power AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > 10
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM joined;
UTIL-MONTHLY.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

UTIL-INTERVAL.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_interval_fault.sql — BAS 15m vs utility interval (rolling MAE proxy)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh (canonical interval_energy); UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE is kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    electric_energy,
    electric_power,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL OR electric_power IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_power AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > 5 THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM agg;
UTIL-INTERVAL.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

COIL-PERF.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- coil_perf.sql — Generic coil performance (#1641): a heating or cooling coil commanded open does not change the air
-- temperature by MIN_DT. One rule for any coil-bearing equipment, applied by bound roles (never by equipment names).
--
-- Mode per sample:
--   heating: heating valve (heating_valve_position_command, else terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command) >= VALVE_OPEN and the cooling valve, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
--   cooling: cooling valve >= VALVE_OPEN and the heating / reheat valves, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
-- Temperature pair, the first complete one in this order (entering -> leaving):
--   1. dedicated coil sensors (heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature / _leaving_temp, cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature / _leaving_temp)
--   2. air handler: mixed_air_temperature -> discharge_air_temperature
--   3. VAV reheat: terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature -> terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature
--   4. fan coil / zone: zone_air_temperature -> discharge_air_temperature
-- Fault: heating and (leave - enter) < MIN_DT, or cooling and (enter - leave) < MIN_DT, with the fan on (supply_fan_operating_status, else
-- supply_fan_command) and, where discharge_air_volume_flow_rate is bound, airflow above FLOW_ON_MIN.
-- No coil valve or no temperature pair on any sample -> assessment 'no_coil_valve' / 'no_temperature_pair':
-- fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass). Run-proof gated like the other air-side rules (#1608).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(heating_valve_position_command, terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command) AS htg,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    heating_valve_position_command,
    terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command,
    discharge_air_volume_flow_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature - heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - mixed_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature - terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - zone_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature - cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN mixed_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature - terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN zone_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  -- not assessable: no coil valve with data, or no complete temperature pair (reported, never a silent pass)
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate <= 11.798675 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= 80 AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= 5)
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < 3 THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= 80
       AND (heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR heating_valve_position_command <= 5)
       AND (terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command <= 5)
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
                     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  (SELECT px.assessment FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate <= 11.798675 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= 80 AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= 5)
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < 3 THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= 80
       AND (heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR heating_valve_position_command <= 5)
       AND (terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command <= 5)
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

SHORT-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- short_cycle.sql — Boiler / compressor short cycling (#1781): too many starts in the trailing hour, or repeated
-- on-times shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS, read from proven run status (never a command).
--
-- Proof, the first candidate that is ever on (> 0.05), else the first one bound: boiler_operating_status, compressor_operating_status,
-- chiller_operating_status, chiller_electric_current > MECH_AMPS_MIN, chiller_electric_power > MECH_POWER_KW_MIN. None bound -> assessment
-- 'no_run_status': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass).
--
-- Duty-aware: a status sample is the on-fraction of its interval (NF resamples a 0/1 status by AVERAGE, so a bucket
-- holds a duty, never a max). Duty <= 0.05 is off, >= 0.95 is on for the whole interval, anything between is a
-- partial sample that must hold a start or a stop. Starts are the FEWEST consistent with the duties: one on-period
-- (cycle) spans whole-on samples and can begin or end only inside a partial sample, so in a run of non-off samples a
-- partial sample closes the cycle that is already open and the next sample opens a new one. A cycle's start counts
-- when it is seen (an off sample before it, or a stop inside the run); its on-time is the duty-weighted held time.
-- A completed cycle (start and stop both seen) shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS is a short cycle.
--
-- A sample is in fault when, over the trailing hour (t - 3600 s, t], starts > MAX_STARTS_PER_HOUR or short cycles
-- >= MIN_SHORT_CYCLES. No confirmation delay: the counts already span the hour. On a trend coarser than
-- MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS the counts are floors: a sample whose hour holds such an interval is fault time when the
-- floor reaches the threshold (assessment 'coarse_floor'), and otherwise unknown (not covered). Nothing covered ->
-- 'insufficient_trend' (NOT ASSESSED).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_s,
    boiler_operating_status AS c1,
    compressor_operating_status AS c2,
    chiller_operating_status AS c3,
    CASE WHEN chiller_electric_current IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_electric_current > 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c4,
    CASE WHEN chiller_electric_power IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_electric_power > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c5
  FROM history
),
pick AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(c1) > 0.05 THEN 1 WHEN MAX(c2) > 0.05 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(c3) > 0.05 THEN 3
      WHEN MAX(c4) > 0.05 THEN 4 WHEN MAX(c5) > 0.05 THEN 5
      WHEN COUNT(c1) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(c2) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(c3) > 0 THEN 3
      WHEN COUNT(c4) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COUNT(c5) > 0 THEN 5
      ELSE 0
    END AS proof_kind
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
proof AS (
  SELECT h.equipment_id, h.timestamp_utc, h.epoch_s,
    CASE p.proof_kind WHEN 1 THEN h.c1 WHEN 2 THEN h.c2 WHEN 3 THEN h.c3 WHEN 4 THEN h.c4 WHEN 5 THEN h.c5 ELSE NULL END AS v
  FROM h
  JOIN pick p ON p.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
nb AS (
  -- valid proof samples only; neighbours are the previous / next valid sample
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    epoch_s,
    CASE WHEN v < 0.0 THEN 0.0 WHEN v >= 1.0 THEN 1.0 ELSE v END AS u,
    CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cls,
    LAG(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS prev_cls,
    LEAD(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS next_cls,
    epoch_s - LAG(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS dt_back,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_fwd
  FROM proof
  WHERE v IS NOT NULL
),
runs AS (
  SELECT
    nb.*,
    -- a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS breaks the sequence: nothing is known across it
    CASE WHEN dt_back IS NULL OR dt_back > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brk,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > 0.0 AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 THEN dt_fwd ELSE 0.0 END AS held_s,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 AND next_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS off_next,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > 900 AND dt_fwd <= 1 * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS coarse
  FROM nb
),
pos AS (
  -- non-off samples; a run is a sequence of them with no off sample and no gap
  SELECT
    runs.*,
    CASE WHEN brk = 1 OR prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_start,
    CASE WHEN brk = 0 AND prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS seen_rise,
    CASE WHEN cls = 1 AND (brk = 1 OR prev_cls <> 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS chain_start
  FROM runs
  WHERE cls > 0
),
chains AS (
  SELECT
    pos.*,
    SUM(chain_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS chain_id
  FROM pos
),
chain_pos AS (
  -- k: position of a partial sample in its chain of consecutive partial samples
  SELECT
    chains.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id, cls ORDER BY epoch_s) - 1 AS k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN chain_start = 1 THEN run_start ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id) AS chain_at_run_start
  FROM chains
),
closing AS (
  -- a partial sample closes the open cycle unless it opened that cycle itself
  SELECT
    chain_pos.*,
    CASE
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 1 AND k % 2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 0 AND k % 2 = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS closes
  FROM chain_pos
),
opens AS (
  SELECT
    closing.*,
    CASE
      WHEN run_start = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN LAG(closes) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cycle_start
  FROM closing
),
cycles AS (
  SELECT
    opens.*,
    CASE WHEN cycle_start = 1 AND (run_start = 0 OR seen_rise = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_evt,
    SUM(cycle_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cycle_id
  FROM opens
),
cycle_sum AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    MAX(timestamp_utc) AS end_ts,
    MAX(start_evt) AS seen_start,
    MAX(CASE WHEN closes = 1 OR off_next = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_stop,
    SUM(u * held_s) AS on_s
  FROM cycles
  GROUP BY equipment_id, cycle_id
),
ev AS (
  SELECT
    r.equipment_id,
    r.timestamp_utc,
    r.epoch_s,
    r.coarse,
    COALESCE(c.start_evt, 0) AS start_evt,
    CASE WHEN s.equipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS short_evt
  FROM runs r
  LEFT JOIN cycles c
    ON c.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND c.timestamp_utc = r.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN cycle_sum s
    ON s.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND s.end_ts = r.timestamp_utc
   AND s.seen_start = 1 AND s.seen_stop = 1 AND s.on_s < 600
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(start_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS starts_h,
    SUM(short_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS short_h,
    MAX(coarse) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS coarse_h
  FROM ev
),
judged AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    coarse_h,
    CASE WHEN starts_h > 6 OR short_h >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
held AS (
  -- forward sample-and-hold over every history row (the last row and a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS hold nothing)
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_seconds
  FROM h
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    hd.equipment_id,
    hd.timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN j.equipment_id IS NULL THEN 0.0
      WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 0 THEN 0.0
      WHEN hd.dt_seconds IS NULL OR hd.dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR hd.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 0.0
      ELSE hd.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    COALESCE(j.raw_fault, 0) AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS floor_fault
  FROM held hd
  LEFT JOIN judged j
    ON j.equipment_id = hd.equipment_id AND j.timestamp_utc = hd.timestamp_utc
)
SELECT
  p.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(a.fault_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(a.covered_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(100.0 * a.fault_s / a.covered_s AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 THEN 'no_run_status'
    WHEN COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 'insufficient_trend'
    WHEN a.floor_fault = 1 THEN 'coarse_floor'
    ELSE 'assessed'
  END AS assessment
FROM pick p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_s,
    SUM(held_seconds) AS covered_s,
    MAX(CASE WHEN floor_fault = 1 AND held_seconds > 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS floor_fault
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) a ON a.equipment_id = p.equipment_id;

XS-MIX.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- xs_mix.sql — Cross-sensor consistency (#1780): mixed-air temperature outside the outdoor / return mixing envelope.
-- A sensor or mapping finding, not an economizer fault: with the fan proven on, mixed_air_temperature must lie in
--   [min(outdoor_air_intake_temperature, return_air_temperature) - MIX_BAND, max(outdoor_air_intake_temperature, return_air_temperature) + MIX_BAND]
-- at any damper position (closed: mixed_air_temperature ~ return_air_temperature, open: mixed_air_temperature ~ outdoor_air_intake_temperature). Fan on: supply_fan_operating_status, else supply_fan_command, else the run proof.
-- No sample with mixed_air_temperature, outdoor_air_intake_temperature and return_air_temperature together -> assessment 'no_temperatures'; no run proof bound (gate on) ->
-- 'no_run_proof'. Not assessed: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass). Run-proof gated (#1608).
WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mixed_air_temperature,
    CASE WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature < return_air_temperature THEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature ELSE return_air_temperature END AS env_lo,
    CASE WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature > return_air_temperature THEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature ELSE return_air_temperature END AS env_hi,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
inputs AS (
  SELECT h.equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND h.env_lo IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'no_temperatures'
      WHEN MAX(rp.no_run_proof) = 1 THEN 'no_run_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM h
  JOIN rp ON rp.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
  GROUP BY h.equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    i.assessment,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN h.fan_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature IS NULL OR h.env_lo IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature < h.env_lo - 1.111111 THEN 1
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature > h.env_hi + 1.111111 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
  JOIN inputs i ON i.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    return_air_temperature, mixed_air_temperature, zone_air_temperature,

    CASE WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND return_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(mixed_air_temperature - return_air_temperature) <= 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m3,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(zone_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature) <= 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m4,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
         THEN CASE WHEN ABS(zone_air_temperature - terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature) <= 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m5
  FROM history

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- xs_clip.sql — Cross-sensor consistency (#1780): a transmitter clipped at a round full scale (an instrumentation
-- finding, not a range fault: the value may be inside the SV-RANGE bounds).
-- Roles and their round step (SI): zone_air_co2 (CO2_ROUND ppm), discharge_air_static_pressure (STATIC_ROUND Pa), discharge_air_volume_flow_rate (FLOW_ROUND L/s).
-- discharge_air_static_pressure and discharge_air_volume_flow_rate count only fan-on samples (supply_fan_operating_status, else supply_fan_command, else operating_status, else every sample).
-- A role is clipped when its highest counted value is a positive multiple of its round step, at least CLIP_SHARE
-- percent of its counted samples sit at that value (within 1e-6; CLIP_SHARE is 0-100, QUDT PERCENT), and the series
-- is not flat (some sample is lower). A design maximum
-- that is not round, or reached once, is not clipped.
-- Fault: a counted sample of a clipped role at the clip value, held for CONFIRM_SECONDS. No role with data ->
-- assessment 'no_clip_role': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass).
WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_air_co2 AS v1,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.01 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         ELSE discharge_air_static_pressure END AS v2,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.01 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         ELSE discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END AS v3,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_co2 IS NULL AND discharge_air_static_pressure IS NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_role
  FROM history
),
tops AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(v1) AS t1, MIN(v1) AS l1, COUNT(v1) AS c1,
    MAX(v2) AS t2, MIN(v2) AS l2, COUNT(v2) AS c2,
    MAX(v3) AS t3, MIN(v3) AS l3, COUNT(v3) AS c3,
    CASE WHEN SUM(has_role) = 0 THEN 'no_clip_role' ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM v
  GROUP BY equipment_id

  SELECT v.equipment_id, v.timestamp_utc,

WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_air_co2 AS v1,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.01 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         ELSE discharge_air_static_pressure END AS v2,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.01 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         ELSE discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END AS v3,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_co2 IS NULL AND discharge_air_static_pressure IS NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_role
  FROM history
),
tops AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(v1) AS t1, MIN(v1) AS l1, COUNT(v1) AS c1,
    MAX(v2) AS t2, MIN(v2) AS l2, COUNT(v2) AS c2,
    MAX(v3) AS t3, MIN(v3) AS l3, COUNT(v3) AS c3,
    CASE WHEN SUM(has_role) = 0 THEN 'no_clip_role' ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM v
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
at_top AS (
  SELECT v.equipment_id, v.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN v.v1 IS NOT NULL AND v.v1 >= t.t1 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a1,
    CASE WHEN v.v2 IS NOT NULL AND v.v2 >= t.t2 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a2,
    CASE WHEN v.v3 IS NOT NULL AND v.v3 >= t.t3 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a3
  FROM v
  JOIN tops t ON t.equipment_id = v.equipment_id
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT t.equipment_id, t.assessment,
    CASE WHEN t.t1 > 0 AND t.l1 < t.t1 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t1 - 100 * ROUND(t.t1 / 100)) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a1) >= 5 * t.c1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k1,
    CASE WHEN t.t2 > 0 AND t.l2 < t.t2 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t2 - 25 * ROUND(t.t2 / 25)) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a2) >= 5 * t.c2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k2,
    CASE WHEN t.t3 > 0 AND t.l3 < t.t3 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t3 - 50 * ROUND(t.t3 / 50)) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a3) >= 5 * t.c3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k3
  FROM tops t
  JOIN at_top a ON a.equipment_id = t.equipment_id
  GROUP BY t.equipment_id, t.assessment, t.t1, t.l1, t.c1, t.t2, t.l2, t.c2, t.t3, t.l3, t.c3
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.equipment_id,
    a.timestamp_utc,
    k.assessment,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN k.k1 = 1 AND a.a1 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN k.k2 = 1 AND a.a2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN k.k3 = 1 AND a.a3 = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM at_top a
  JOIN clipped k ON k.equipment_id = a.equipment_id
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    assessment,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - 1 * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((energized = 1 AND (__OFDD_SV_RANGE_BANDS__))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  -- #1673: time beyond MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS of a gap is unknown here (not covered, not a fault); SV-STALE scores gaps.
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = ss.equipment_id), CASE WHEN 1 >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) END AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;

    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > __OFDD_SV_RATE_THRESHOLD__ THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 AND energized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed,
    held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE held_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 AND equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while supply_fan_command > 0.5.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    supply_fan_command AS supply_fan_command,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    supply_fan_command,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

VAV-1.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occupancy_status is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occupancy_status from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occupancy_status exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference supply_fan_command here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack supply_fan_command; the rule is then → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_air_temperature,
    occupancy_status,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature < {{ZONE_T_LO}} OR zone_air_temperature > {{ZONE_T_HI}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_OCCUPIED}} >= 0.5
       AND occupancy_status IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- zone_comfort_pct.sql
-- Comfort is the share of eligible elapsed time inside the band, not a row count.
-- Band placeholders ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI and history zone_air_temperature are SI °C (metric pack).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)

  equipment_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_air_temperature >= {{ZONE_T_LO}} AND zone_air_temperature <= {{ZONE_T_HI}} THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS comfort_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fault_elapsed_hours.sql — comfort fault elapsed rollup
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_air_temperature and ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI are °C.
-- Out-of-band zone temperature holds forward until the next sample.
-- Gaps longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS are unknown (not fault, not covered).

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,

      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds

  WHERE zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)

  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature < {{ZONE_T_LO}} OR zone_air_temperature > {{ZONE_T_HI}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fault_samples,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_air_temperature < {{ZONE_T_LO}} OR zone_air_temperature > {{ZONE_T_HI}} THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): outdoor_air_intake_temperature and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment weather_service_air_temperature (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, weather_service_air_temperature AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, weather_service_air_temperature AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.outdoor_air_intake_temperature,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sat_high_fault.sql — FC13 SAT above SP at full cooling + confirm (matches cookbook fc13)
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    discharge_air_temperature,
    discharge_air_temperature_setpoint,
    COALESCE(cooling_valve_position_command, 0.0) AS cooling_valve_position_command,
    COALESCE(outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command, 0.0) AS outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command,
    supply_fan_command,
    supply_fan_operating_status,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
       AND cooling_valve_position_command > {{CLG_FULL_MIN}}
       AND discharge_air_temperature > discharge_air_temperature_setpoint + {{EPS_SAT}}
       AND (outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command <= {{OA_DAMPER_ECON_LOW}} OR outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command > {{ECON_FULL_OPEN}})
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
