  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mixed_air_temperature,
    outdoor_air_intake_temperature,
    return_air_temperature,
    COALESCE(COALESCE(supply_fan_command, 0.0), 0.0) AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NOT NULL AND return_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
       AND (mixed_air_temperature - {{EPS_MAT}}) > (CASE WHEN return_air_temperature > outdoor_air_intake_temperature THEN return_air_temperature + {{EPS_RAT}} ELSE outdoor_air_intake_temperature + {{EPS_OAT}} END)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    discharge_air_temperature,
    mixed_air_temperature,
    COALESCE(outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command, 0.0) AS outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command,
    COALESCE(cooling_valve_position_command, 0.0) AS cooling_valve_position_command,
    supply_fan_command,
    supply_fan_operating_status,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND cooling_valve_position_command > {{CLG_ON_MIN}}
       AND (discharge_air_temperature - {{MIX_TOL}} - {{DELTA_SUPPLY_FAN}}) > (mixed_air_temperature + {{MIX_TOL}})
       AND (outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command <= {{ECON_MIN_POS}} OR outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command > {{ECON_FULL_OPEN}})
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT f.equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM f.timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch,
  CASE WHEN c.cov_pct < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0 ELSE f.confirmed END AS confirmed,
  f.held_seconds
FROM final f LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id WHERE f.equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY f.equipment_id, f.timestamp_utc

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- econ1_stuck_closed.sql — ECON-1 economizer stuck closed
-- CAST DOUBLE. supply_fan_command and outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command are fractions 0-1 (input_contract.sql), no magnitude guess.
-- Pandas _fan is fan-cmd first, then fan-status (> 0.5).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN CASE
        WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE
          WHEN CAST(supply_fan_command AS DOUBLE PRECISION) > 0.01 THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
        WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN CAST(supply_fan_operating_status AS DOUBLE PRECISION) > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0
      END = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command IS NOT NULL AND outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NOT NULL
       AND CAST(outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < {{ECON1_DAMPER_MAX}}
       AND CAST(outdoor_air_intake_temperature AS DOUBLE PRECISION) > {{ECON1_OAT_MIN}}
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'chilled_water_volume_flow_rate', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate', 'chilled_water_pressure_delta', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature', 'chiller_electric_power')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value

  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs

  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa

    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'supply_condenser_water_temperature', 'return_condenser_water_temperature')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((({{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 OR (energized = 1 AND coverage_pct >= {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}})) AND (__OFDD_SV_SPIKE_BANDS__))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}}
         THEN dt_seconds - {{MAX_SILENCE_SECONDS}} ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 AND equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

SV-STALE.sql:
-- SV-STALE (#1673): missing data. A sensor series is stale while it has no valid sample for longer than
-- STALE_AFTER_HOURS. This rule has no value test (a stuck value that is still polled is SV-FLATLINE) and no
-- run-proof gate (data monitoring does not depend on the motor).
--
-- Expected series: `sweep_series` lists every bound series the caller fetched successfully, with its requested
-- window [window_start, window_end). A bound series with no sample at all is therefore assessed (it faults for
-- the whole window beyond STALE_AFTER_HOURS). A series the caller could not fetch is not listed and is not
-- assessed. Callers that do not fill `sweep_series` get the series present in `sensor_history`, over the
-- equipment's observed window (first to last timestamp in history and sensor_history).
--
-- Per series, the window start, every valid sample and the window end split the window into intervals. An
-- interval longer than STALE_AFTER_SECONDS contributes (interval - STALE_AFTER_SECONDS) of fault time, starting
-- STALE_AFTER_SECONDS after its first point. covered_hours is the whole window.
WITH eq_window AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, MIN(epoch_seconds) AS start_epoch, MAX(epoch_seconds) AS end_epoch
  FROM (
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM history
    UNION ALL
    SELECT equipment_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds FROM sensor_history
    WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  ) observed
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
declared AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_start)) AS start_epoch, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM window_end)) AS end_epoch
  FROM sweep_series
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
observed_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, MIN(sensor_role) AS sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature', 'supply_chilled_water_temperature', 'return_chilled_water_temperature', 'supply_hot_water_temperature', 'return_hot_water_temperature', 'outdoor_air_intake_relative_humidity', 'return_air_relative_humidity', 'zone_air_relative_humidity', 'mixed_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_relative_humidity', 'discharge_air_static_pressure', 'discharge_air_volume_flow_rate')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id
),
expected AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch, end_epoch FROM declared
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.equipment_id, o.series_id, o.sensor_role, w.start_epoch, w.end_epoch
  FROM observed_series o
  JOIN eq_window w ON w.equipment_id = o.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN declared d ON d.equipment_id = o.equipment_id AND d.series_id = o.series_id
  WHERE d.series_id IS NULL
),
points AS (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM expected e
  JOIN sensor_history s ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND s.series_id = e.series_id
  WHERE fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) >= e.start_epoch
    AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) <= e.end_epoch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, start_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, end_epoch AS epoch_seconds FROM expected
),
steps AS (
  SELECT points.*,
    LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS next_epoch
  FROM points
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds, next_epoch - epoch_seconds AS dt_seconds
  FROM steps
  WHERE next_epoch IS NOT NULL AND next_epoch > epoch_seconds
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch, 0 AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} THEN {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} ELSE dt_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds + {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} AS segment_epoch, 1 AS confirmed,
    dt_seconds - {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}} AS held_seconds
  FROM intervals
  WHERE dt_seconds > {{STALE_AFTER_SECONDS}}
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT e.equipment_id, e.series_id, e.sensor_role,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN scored ON scored.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND scored.series_id = e.series_id
ORDER BY e.equipment_id, e.series_id;

SV-RATE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Sensor-series input and output are keyed by the bound point UUID, not the role.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
-- #1631: bounded as-of proof per (equipment, sample time) with window functions (no correlated subquery, so it scales on
-- PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB): proof rows and the distinct sample times of one equipment are interleaved in time order
-- (a proof row sorts before a sample at the same instant); a running count of proof rows tags every sample with the
-- latest proof row at or before it; that row's proof is used when it is less than MAX_GAP_HOURS older than the sample.
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    -- #1631: the proof of a sample is the latest proof row at or before it, held for at most MAX_GAP_HOURS (proof_asof).
    -- No such row (or a NULL proof) is UNKNOWN: it cannot create a fault. With the gate off every sample is eligible.
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > __OFDD_SV_RATE_THRESHOLD__ THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 AND energized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN h.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sample_times AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds
  FROM sensor_history
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
    AND sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
proof_stream AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds, 0 AS stream_kind, energized
  FROM base_proof
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, epoch_seconds, 1 AS stream_kind, NULL AS energized
  FROM sample_times
),
proof_tagged AS (
  SELECT proof_stream.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds, stream_kind ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS proof_group
  FROM proof_stream
),
proof_carried AS (
  SELECT proof_tagged.*,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN epoch_seconds END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_epoch,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stream_kind = 0 THEN energized END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, proof_group) AS proof_energized
  FROM proof_tagged
),
proof_asof AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN proof_epoch IS NOT NULL AND proof_epoch > epoch_seconds - {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
      THEN proof_energized ELSE NULL END AS energized
  FROM proof_carried
  WHERE stream_kind = 1
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(pa.energized, CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  LEFT JOIN proof_asof pa
    ON pa.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND pa.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    AND s.sensor_role IN ('outdoor_air_intake_temperature', 'mixed_air_temperature', 'zone_air_temperature', 'return_air_temperature', 'discharge_air_temperature')
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > __OFDD_SV_RATE_THRESHOLD__ THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 AND energized = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed,
    held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE held_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 AND equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- pid_hunt_1.sql — Suspected control-output hunting (rolling 1h metrics)
-- Matches pandas hunting_fault_mask: TV / span / cycles / reversals over
-- WINDOW_HOURS. The detection window is still a row frame (WINDOW_ROWS).
-- Fault hours integrate eligible forward deltas and do not add a phantom
-- interval after the last sample. {{WINDOW_ROWS}} / {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}}
-- are derived from WINDOW_HOURS + POLL_SECONDS (literal ROWS bounds).
-- Control outputs arrive as PERCENT 0-100 (the ingest converts a fraction source once). Span, deadband
-- and variation thresholds are percent points; do not scale the column again.
-- exactly here, once, because the *_PCT parameters (span, deadband, total variation) are percent points.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(operating_status) AS operating_status
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command
      WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        cooling_valve_position_command
      WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
        heating_valve_position_command
      WHEN damper_position IS NOT NULL THEN
        damper_position
      ELSE NULL
    END AS out_pct,
    LAG(
      CASE
        WHEN outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command
        WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          cooling_valve_position_command
        WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL THEN
          heating_valve_position_command
        WHEN damper_position IS NOT NULL THEN
          damper_position
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_out,
    COALESCE(operating_mode_status, 1.0) AS loop_on,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_out IS NULL OR out_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(out_pct - prev_out) >= {{CHANGE_DEADBAND_PCT}} THEN out_pct - prev_out
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS sig_delta
  FROM h
),
steps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(sig_delta)
    END AS abs_step,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL OR sig_delta = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sig_delta * LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) < 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS reversal_event
  FROM deltas
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    out_pct,
    fan_on,
    loop_on,
    COUNT(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS n_samples,
    SUM(abs_step) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS tv,
    MAX(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - MIN(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS span,
    SUM(reversal_event) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN {{WINDOW_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS reversals
  FROM steps
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN loop_on IS NOT NULL AND loop_on <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN out_pct IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN n_samples < CAST(CEIL({{WINDOW_ROWS}} * {{MINIMUM_COVERAGE_PCT}} / 100.0) AS INT) THEN 0
      WHEN span < {{MINIMUM_SPAN_PCT}} THEN 0
      WHEN tv < {{TOTAL_VARIATION_FAULT_PCT}} THEN 0
      WHEN span <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (tv / (2.0 * NULLIF(span, 0))) < {{MINIMUM_EQUIVALENT_CYCLES}} THEN 0
      WHEN reversals < {{MINIMUM_REVERSALS}} THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM win
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc4_os_hunting.sql — PID hunting (operating-state oscillation), GL36 fault 4
-- ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the clock hour: count how many times the AHU *enters* each
-- operating state within the hour and flag the whole hour when any state is
-- entered more than DELTA_OS_MAX times.
-- Operating states: 1 = min OA / heating, 2 = economizer, 3 = mechanical cooling
-- (0 = fan off, not counted).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
rps AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, MAX(operating_status) AS operating_status
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command AS oa_d,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE supply_fan_command
    END AS fan,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
modes AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', h.timestamp_utc) AS clock_hour,
    CASE
      WHEN fan IS NULL OR fan < 0.5 THEN 0
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg > 0.1 THEN 3
      WHEN oa_d IS NOT NULL AND oa_d > 0.5 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS op_mode,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN rps.operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proven
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
-- #1631: entries are counted over PROVEN samples only (the sequence skips unproven time, so a transition across
-- unproven time is not an entry and an unproven flap cannot reach the hourly count); pandas fc4 does the same.
entries AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    clock_hour,
    op_mode,
    CASE
      WHEN op_mode = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN op_mode <> LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_entry
  FROM modes
  WHERE proven = 1
),
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    clock_hour,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_min_oa,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_econ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_mech
  FROM entries
  GROUP BY equipment_id, clock_hour
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT
    m.equipment_id,
    m.timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_min_oa, 0) AS entries_min_oa,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_econ, 0) AS entries_econ,
    COALESCE(hc.entries_mech, 0) AS entries_mech
  FROM modes m
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON hc.equipment_id = m.equipment_id AND hc.clock_hour = m.clock_hour
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN entries_min_oa > {{DELTA_OS_MAX}} THEN 1
      WHEN entries_econ > {{DELTA_OS_MAX}} THEN 1
      WHEN entries_mech > {{DELTA_OS_MAX}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM hourly
  LEFT JOIN rps USING (equipment_id, timestamp_utc)
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

-- fc6_oa_frac_mismatch.sql — Estimated OA fraction mismatch (GL36 fault 6)
-- |RATavg − OATavg| >= ΔTmin AND |estimated OA% − design min OA%| > εF, where
-- design min OA% = MIN_FLOW_DESIGN / total VAV airflow.
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mixed_air_temperature, return_air_temperature, outdoor_air_intake_temperature, terminal_unit_discharge_air_total_volume_flow_rate,
    supply_fan_command AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL OR outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_total_volume_flow_rate IS NULL OR terminal_unit_discharge_air_total_volume_flow_rate <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN fan < 0.5 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(return_air_temperature - outdoor_air_intake_temperature) < {{OAT_RAT_DELTA_MIN}} THEN 0
      WHEN ABS((mixed_air_temperature - return_air_temperature) / NULLIF(outdoor_air_intake_temperature - return_air_temperature, 0)

      ELSE 0

    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)

  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h

elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after

    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (

    FROM base src
  ) stepped

lagged AS (
  SELECT

      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)

    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),

  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)

  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc

-- burner with no hot-water coil is not applicable (required coil roles).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
-- #1631: require_run_proof = 0 switches off only the resolved run-proof gate; the rule keeps its own fan condition,
-- fan-restart holdoff and active-coverage floor (as pandas: the operational gate is not the run-proof gate).
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature AS enter_t,
    heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature AS leave_t,
    COALESCE(heating_valve_position_command, 0.0) AS htg,
    COALESCE(cooling_valve_position_command, 0.0) AS clg,
    COALESCE(supply_fan_command, 0.0) AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN enter_t IS NULL OR leave_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan < 0.5 THEN 0
      WHEN htg > {{HTG_ON_MIN}} THEN 0
      WHEN clg > {{CLG_ON_MIN}} THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(enter_t - leave_t) >= SQRT(2.0 * {{EPS_MAT}} * {{EPS_MAT}}) + {{DELTA_SUPPLY_FAN}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN {{MODE_DELAY_ROWS_PRECEDING}} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = f.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CASE
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < {{MINIMUM_ACTIVE_COVERAGE_PCT}} THEN 0.0
    ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.proof_active = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
  END END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

-- Equation: static > SP + DUCT_HIGH_MARGIN.
-- Gate: fan-on from supply_fan_operating_status then supply_fan_command. Missing fan stays NULL
-- (do not ELSE 1). Pressure-on substitutes only when fan proof is absent,
-- never when status/cmd is proven 0 (frozen overnight static).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    discharge_air_static_pressure, discharge_air_static_pressure_setpoint,
    supply_fan_command AS fan,
    CASE

-- hw_oat_1.sql — Hot-water plant proven on above 18.3 °C web OAT (#1782): the summer-lockout twin of MECH-OAT-1.
-- Proven on, per sample: the hot-water pump status (pump_operating_status > 0.05) or the hot-water supply temperature above the
-- running cut (supply_hot_water_temperature > HW_ON_MIN). Neither bound on any sample -> assessment 'no_proof'.
-- Web dry bulb as MECH-OAT-1: the equipment's weather_service_air_temperature, else the weather sidecar joined as-of (latest sample at or before
-- the row, at most WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS old). No outdoor-air sample at all -> assessment 'no_outdoor_air'.
-- Not assessed: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 and no timeline samples (never a silent pass). A sample with no OAT or
-- with neither proof value is unknown: no covered time (fault_pct denominator) and no timeline sample.
-- Fault: proven on while the web dry bulb AT THAT SAMPLE is above HW_OAT_MIN (never a daily maximum, so a cold morning
-- is never a fault), held for CONFIRM_SECONDS (the settle time).
WITH wx_web_oa_t AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc AS ref_ts, ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(weather_service_air_temperature) AS ref_val
    FROM weather
    WHERE weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY timestamp_utc
  ) wx_web_oa_t_points
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(h.weather_service_air_temperature, wx_web_oa_t.ref_val) AS weather_service_air_temperature,
    CASE WHEN h.pump_operating_status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN h.supply_hot_water_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN h.supply_hot_water_temperature > {{HW_ON_MIN}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c2
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN wx_web_oa_t
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts
   AND (wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wx_web_oa_t.next_ref_ts)
   AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wx_web_oa_t.ref_ts)) <= {{WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS}}
),
inputs AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(weather_service_air_temperature) = 0 THEN 'no_outdoor_air'
      WHEN COUNT(c1) + COUNT(c2) = 0 THEN 'no_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    i.assessment,
    CASE WHEN h.weather_service_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND (h.c1 IS NOT NULL OR h.c2 IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS known,

WITH rp AS (

  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mixed_air_temperature, return_air_temperature, outdoor_air_intake_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL OR outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(return_air_temperature - outdoor_air_intake_temperature) <= {{OAT_RAT_GUARD}} THEN 0
      WHEN 100.0 * (mixed_air_temperature - return_air_temperature) / NULLIF(outdoor_air_intake_temperature - return_air_temperature, 0) < {{MIN_OA_FRAC}}
       AND fan_on = 1 THEN 1   -- #1642: fan = status when bound, else command, as pandas _fan
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds

    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

  FROM elapsed_hold
),

  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
