    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    supply_condenser_water_temperature, weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature,
    cooling_tower_fan_command AS fan,
    pump_operating_status,
    chiller_operating_status,
    chilled_water_volume_flow_rate,
    chilled_water_pump_command,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS proof_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN supply_condenser_water_temperature IS NULL OR weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan >= 0.5
       AND (supply_condenser_water_temperature - weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature) > {{APPROACH_MAX}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    supply_condenser_water_temperature, weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature,
    cooling_tower_fan_command AS fan,
    pump_operating_status,
    chiller_operating_status,
    chilled_water_volume_flow_rate,
    chilled_water_pump_command,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_volume_flow_rate > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      -- #1631: no legacy plant point bound = unknown, not OFF; the resolved operating_status gate decides (as TRIM-3/4, #1710)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS proof_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN supply_condenser_water_temperature IS NULL OR weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan >= 0.5
       AND supply_condenser_water_temperature > weather_service_air_wet_bulb_temperature + {{CW_APPROACH}} + {{EXCESS_BEYOND_APPROACH}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h

  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.

-- sched1_unoccupied_runtime.sql — Excess / wasted unoccupied runtime
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_air_temperature and the ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI comfort band are °C.
-- Pandas sched1: unoccupied & fan_on; when zone_air_temperature mapped, also require comfort band
-- (zone already satisfied → optimal-start / bad schedule signal).
-- When zone_air_temperature is absent from history, the runner injects NULL zone_air_temperature (optional role)
-- so behavior matches pandas “no zone → base only”.
-- Portable occupancy: literal 'unoccupied' OR numeric/boolean falsey (0 / 0.0 / false).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
        CAST(CASE
          WHEN occupancy_status IS NULL OR supply_fan_operating_status IS NULL THEN 0
          WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.5
            AND (
              LOWER(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IN
                ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
              OR (
                fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
                AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occupancy_status AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
              )
            )
            AND (
              zone_air_temperature IS NULL
              OR (zone_air_temperature >= {{ZONE_T_LO}} AND zone_air_temperature <= {{ZONE_T_HI}})
            )
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sched247_always_on.sql — Always-on fan or pump runtime (#1670)
-- ALWAYS_ON_PCT is a percent of proven run time (95 means 95%).
--
-- Proof per sample: the first non-NULL status (fan, pump, chw pump, chiller, compressor, chiller current) wins over
-- the commands (tower fan, fan, chw pump); run when > 0.05 (sql/fdd/operating_status.json threshold); a sample with
-- neither is UNKNOWN (never a proven OFF). Each sample holds forward to the next one; a hold longer than
-- MAX_GAP_HOURS, and the last sample, hold nothing.
--
-- Durations (hours): window = first..last history row of the equipment (the observed window);
-- proven_on / proven_off = held time with known proof; unknown = window - proven_on - proven_off.
-- Completeness: the verdict needs proven time >= 0.9 * max(window, 24 h). "Always on" is judged on the
-- observed window but never on less than one day of proof. Otherwise assessment = 'insufficient_proof'
-- (or 'no_proof' when nothing is known) and fault_hours / fault_pct are NULL.
-- Qualifier: proven_on / (proven_on + proven_off) >= ALWAYS_ON_PCT (time-weighted). Fault time is the
-- confirmed proven-ON time (CONFIRM_SECONDS streaks) of a qualifying equipment.
WITH proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN compressor_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN compressor_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_electric_current IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_electric_current > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN cooling_tower_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN cooling_tower_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chilled_water_pump_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chilled_water_pump_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS INT) AS on_bit
  FROM history
),
stepped AS (
  SELECT
    proof.*,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM proof
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) OR on_bit IS NULL
      THEN 0.0 ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gap_after
  FROM stepped
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp_utc) - MIN(timestamp_utc))) AS window_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS on_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_bit = 0 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS off_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
verdict AS (
  SELECT
    summary.*,
    CASE
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds <= 0.0 THEN 'no_proof'
      WHEN on_seconds + off_seconds < 0.9 * (CASE WHEN window_seconds > 86400.0 THEN window_seconds ELSE 86400.0 END)
        THEN 'insufficient_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM summary
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.held_seconds,
    h.gap_after,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
       AND 100.0 * v.on_seconds / (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) >= {{ALWAYS_ON_PCT}}
       AND h.on_bit = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM held h
  JOIN verdict v ON v.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM base
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  v.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed' THEN t.fault_seconds / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  (v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.assessment = 'assessed'
    THEN 100.0 * t.fault_seconds / NULLIF(v.on_seconds + v.off_seconds, 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  v.window_seconds / 3600.0 AS window_hours,
  v.on_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_on_hours,
  v.off_seconds / 3600.0 AS proven_off_hours,
  CASE WHEN v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds > 0.0
    THEN (v.window_seconds - v.on_seconds - v.off_seconds) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS unknown_hours,
  v.assessment
FROM verdict v
JOIN (
  SELECT equipment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_seconds
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) t ON t.equipment_id = v.equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-SENSOR-NULL — own zone setpoint exists while a mapped zone sensor is predominantly null.
-- The runner rewrites this file to zero hours when zone_air_temperature is absent from history.
-- Null time and eligible time are eligible forward deltas. A long gap is unknown.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_air_temperature,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_air_temperature,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS eligible_seconds,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN zone_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NULL THEN held_seconds
      ELSE 0.0
    END) AS null_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= {{NULL_FRACTION}}
    THEN null_seconds / 3600.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  eligible_seconds / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= {{NULL_FRACTION}}
    THEN 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_pct
FROM coverage;

A saved value for a retired key is ignored when read and reported as a migration; new saves reject it.

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fcu_htg_coil.sql — first-class FCU screening rule
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, discharge_air_temperature, zone_air_temperature, zone_air_co2,
    heating_valve_position_command AS htg,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    damper_position_command AS dcmd,
    damper_position AS dpos,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
), base AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND fan_on = 1 AND htg >= {{VALVE_OPEN}} AND discharge_air_temperature - zone_air_temperature < {{COIL_DELTA}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM normalized
), elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
), grouped AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-DEADBAND — pass-through FCU setpoints remain site-native Celsius.
-- Duration is the eligible forward delta, not a row count times poll.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint,
    zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
     AND zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint - zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint < {{DEADBAND}}
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL AND zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint IS NOT NULL
     AND zone_cooling_air_temperature_setpoint - zone_heating_air_temperature_setpoint < {{DEADBAND}}
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

FCU-MODE-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-MODE-CYCLE — cumulative heat/cool mode transitions in the analysis window.
-- Hours are eligible forward deltas after the change count reaches MODE_CHANGES.
-- #1642: each sample holds the time to the NEXT sample of any mode (forward sample-and-hold); the change count runs
-- over the heating / cooling samples only. An idle sample is never fault time, and an active sample no longer holds
-- the idle stretch after it (it used to own the gap to the next active sample), as pandas fcu_mode_cycle.
WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL AND cooling_valve_position_command > {{MODE_VALVE_MIN}} THEN -1
      WHEN heating_valve_position_command IS NOT NULL AND heating_valve_position_command > {{MODE_VALVE_MIN}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM modes
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed
  FROM held
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= {{MODE_CHANGES}} THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= {{MODE_CHANGES}} THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;

UTIL-MONTHLY.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_monthly_fault.sql — BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh; UTIL_PCT_ERR is a percent of utility kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    electric_energy,
    electric_power,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL OR electric_power IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timestamp_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_power AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > {{UTIL_PCT_ERR}}
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM joined;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_interval_fault.sql — BAS 15m vs utility interval (rolling MAE proxy)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh (canonical interval_energy); UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE is kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    electric_energy,
    electric_power,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL OR electric_power IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_power AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(electric_energy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE electric_energy IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > {{UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE}} THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM agg;

COIL-PERF.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- coil_perf.sql — Generic coil performance (#1641): a heating or cooling coil commanded open does not change the air
-- temperature by MIN_DT. One rule for any coil-bearing equipment, applied by bound roles (never by equipment names).
--
-- Mode per sample:
--   heating: heating valve (heating_valve_position_command, else terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command) >= VALVE_OPEN and the cooling valve, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
--   cooling: cooling valve >= VALVE_OPEN and the heating / reheat valves, if bound, <= VALVE_SHUT
-- Temperature pair, the first complete one in this order (entering -> leaving):
--   1. dedicated coil sensors (heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature / _leaving_temp, cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature / _leaving_temp)
--   2. air handler: mixed_air_temperature -> discharge_air_temperature
--   3. VAV reheat: terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature -> terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature
--   4. fan coil / zone: zone_air_temperature -> discharge_air_temperature
-- Fault: heating and (leave - enter) < MIN_DT, or cooling and (enter - leave) < MIN_DT, with the fan on (supply_fan_operating_status, else
-- supply_fan_command) and, where discharge_air_volume_flow_rate is bound, airflow above FLOW_ON_MIN.
-- No coil valve or no temperature pair on any sample -> assessment 'no_coil_valve' / 'no_temperature_pair':
-- fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass). Run-proof gated like the other air-side rules (#1608).
WITH rp AS (
  -- Run proof (#1608): the input role operating_status is resolved from the model (own status, own command, feeding equipment).
  -- With the gate on and no proof bound at all, the equipment is SKIPPED: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(heating_valve_position_command, terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command) AS htg,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    heating_valve_position_command,
    terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command,
    discharge_air_volume_flow_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature - heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - mixed_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature - terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - zone_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature - cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN mixed_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature - terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN zone_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  -- not assessable: no coil valve with data, or no complete temperature pair (reported, never a silent pass)
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate <= {{FLOW_ON_MIN}} THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= {{VALVE_OPEN}} AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < {{MIN_DT}} THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= {{VALVE_OPEN}}
       AND (heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR heating_valve_position_command <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND (terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < {{MIN_DT}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT rpx.no_run_proof FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1
         OR (SELECT px.no_pair FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) = 1 THEN NULL
       ELSE COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
                     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0) END AS fault_pct,
  (SELECT px.assessment FROM pairs px WHERE px.equipment_id = final.equipment_id) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(heating_valve_position_command, terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command) AS htg,
    cooling_valve_position_command AS clg,
    heating_valve_position_command,
    terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command,
    discharge_air_volume_flow_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    CASE
      WHEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN heating_coil_outlet_air_temperature - heating_coil_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - mixed_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature - terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN discharge_air_temperature - zone_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS heat_rise,
    CASE
      WHEN cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN cooling_coil_inlet_air_temperature - cooling_coil_outlet_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN mixed_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_unit_inlet_air_temperature - terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature
      WHEN discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN zone_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cool_drop
  FROM history
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 OR COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_pair,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(htg) + COUNT(clg) = 0 THEN 'no_coil_valve'
         WHEN COUNT(heat_rise) + COUNT(cool_drop) = 0 THEN 'no_temperature_pair'
         ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate <= {{FLOW_ON_MIN}} THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NOT NULL AND htg >= {{VALVE_OPEN}} AND (clg IS NULL OR clg <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND heat_rise IS NOT NULL AND heat_rise < {{MIN_DT}} THEN 1
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg >= {{VALVE_OPEN}}
       AND (heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR heating_valve_position_command <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND (terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command IS NULL OR terminal_unit_heating_valve_position_command <= {{VALVE_SHUT}})
       AND cool_drop IS NOT NULL AND cool_drop < {{MIN_DT}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT equipment_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT rpx.equipment_id FROM rp rpx WHERE rpx.no_run_proof = 1) ORDER BY equipment_id, timestamp_utc

SHORT-CYCLE.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- short_cycle.sql — Boiler / compressor short cycling (#1781): too many starts in the trailing hour, or repeated
-- on-times shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS, read from proven run status (never a command).
--
-- Proof, the first candidate that is ever on (> 0.05), else the first one bound: boiler_operating_status, compressor_operating_status,
-- chiller_operating_status, chiller_electric_current > MECH_AMPS_MIN, chiller_electric_power > MECH_POWER_KW_MIN. None bound -> assessment
-- 'no_run_status': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass).
--
-- Duty-aware: a status sample is the on-fraction of its interval (NF resamples a 0/1 status by AVERAGE, so a bucket
-- holds a duty, never a max). Duty <= 0.05 is off, >= 0.95 is on for the whole interval, anything between is a
-- partial sample that must hold a start or a stop. Starts are the FEWEST consistent with the duties: one on-period
-- (cycle) spans whole-on samples and can begin or end only inside a partial sample, so in a run of non-off samples a
-- partial sample closes the cycle that is already open and the next sample opens a new one. A cycle's start counts
-- when it is seen (an off sample before it, or a stop inside the run); its on-time is the duty-weighted held time.
-- A completed cycle (start and stop both seen) shorter than MIN_ON_SECONDS is a short cycle.
--
-- A sample is in fault when, over the trailing hour (t - 3600 s, t], starts > MAX_STARTS_PER_HOUR or short cycles
-- >= MIN_SHORT_CYCLES. No confirmation delay: the counts already span the hour. On a trend coarser than
-- MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS the counts are floors: a sample whose hour holds such an interval is fault time when the
-- floor reaches the threshold (assessment 'coarse_floor'), and otherwise unknown (not covered). Nothing covered ->
-- 'insufficient_trend' (NOT ASSESSED).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc) AS epoch_s,
    boiler_operating_status AS c1,
    compressor_operating_status AS c2,
    chiller_operating_status AS c3,
    CASE WHEN chiller_electric_current IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_electric_current > {{MECH_AMPS_MIN}} THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c4,
    CASE WHEN chiller_electric_power IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN chiller_electric_power > {{MECH_POWER_KW_MIN}} THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS c5
  FROM history
),
pick AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(c1) > 0.05 THEN 1 WHEN MAX(c2) > 0.05 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(c3) > 0.05 THEN 3
      WHEN MAX(c4) > 0.05 THEN 4 WHEN MAX(c5) > 0.05 THEN 5
      WHEN COUNT(c1) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(c2) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(c3) > 0 THEN 3
      WHEN COUNT(c4) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN COUNT(c5) > 0 THEN 5
      ELSE 0
    END AS proof_kind
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
proof AS (
  SELECT h.equipment_id, h.timestamp_utc, h.epoch_s,
    CASE p.proof_kind WHEN 1 THEN h.c1 WHEN 2 THEN h.c2 WHEN 3 THEN h.c3 WHEN 4 THEN h.c4 WHEN 5 THEN h.c5 ELSE NULL END AS v
  FROM h
  JOIN pick p ON p.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
nb AS (
  -- valid proof samples only; neighbours are the previous / next valid sample
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    epoch_s,
    CASE WHEN v < 0.0 THEN 0.0 WHEN v >= 1.0 THEN 1.0 ELSE v END AS u,
    CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cls,
    LAG(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS prev_cls,
    LEAD(CASE WHEN v <= 0.05 THEN 0 WHEN v >= 0.95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS next_cls,
    epoch_s - LAG(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) AS dt_back,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_fwd
  FROM proof
  WHERE v IS NOT NULL
),
runs AS (
  SELECT
    nb.*,
    -- a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS breaks the sequence: nothing is known across it
    CASE WHEN dt_back IS NULL OR dt_back > {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brk,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > 0.0 AND dt_fwd <= {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN dt_fwd ELSE 0.0 END AS held_s,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd <= {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 AND next_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS off_next,
    CASE WHEN dt_fwd IS NOT NULL AND dt_fwd > {{MAX_INTERVAL_SECONDS}} AND dt_fwd <= {{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS coarse
  FROM nb
),
pos AS (
  -- non-off samples; a run is a sequence of them with no off sample and no gap
  SELECT
    runs.*,
    CASE WHEN brk = 1 OR prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_start,
    CASE WHEN brk = 0 AND prev_cls = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS seen_rise,
    CASE WHEN cls = 1 AND (brk = 1 OR prev_cls <> 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS chain_start
  FROM runs
  WHERE cls > 0
),
chains AS (
  SELECT
    pos.*,
    SUM(chain_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS chain_id
  FROM pos
),
chain_pos AS (
  -- k: position of a partial sample in its chain of consecutive partial samples
  SELECT
    chains.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id, cls ORDER BY epoch_s) - 1 AS k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN chain_start = 1 THEN run_start ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, chain_id) AS chain_at_run_start
  FROM chains
),
closing AS (
  -- a partial sample closes the open cycle unless it opened that cycle itself
  SELECT
    chain_pos.*,
    CASE
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 1 AND k % 2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN cls = 1 AND chain_at_run_start = 0 AND k % 2 = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS closes
  FROM chain_pos
),
opens AS (
  SELECT
    closing.*,
    CASE
      WHEN run_start = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN LAG(closes) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS cycle_start
  FROM closing
),
cycles AS (
  SELECT
    opens.*,
    CASE WHEN cycle_start = 1 AND (run_start = 0 OR seen_rise = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_evt,
    SUM(cycle_start) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cycle_id
  FROM opens
),
cycle_sum AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    MAX(timestamp_utc) AS end_ts,
    MAX(start_evt) AS seen_start,
    MAX(CASE WHEN closes = 1 OR off_next = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seen_stop,
    SUM(u * held_s) AS on_s
  FROM cycles
  GROUP BY equipment_id, cycle_id
),
ev AS (
  SELECT
    r.equipment_id,
    r.timestamp_utc,
    r.epoch_s,
    r.coarse,
    COALESCE(c.start_evt, 0) AS start_evt,
    CASE WHEN s.equipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS short_evt
  FROM runs r
  LEFT JOIN cycles c
    ON c.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND c.timestamp_utc = r.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN cycle_sum s
    ON s.equipment_id = r.equipment_id AND s.end_ts = r.timestamp_utc
   AND s.seen_start = 1 AND s.seen_stop = 1 AND s.on_s < {{MIN_ON_SECONDS}}
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(start_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS starts_h,
    SUM(short_evt) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS short_h,
    MAX(coarse) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s RANGE BETWEEN 3599.999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS coarse_h
  FROM ev
),
judged AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    coarse_h,
    CASE WHEN starts_h > {{MAX_STARTS_PER_HOUR}} OR short_h >= {{MIN_SHORT_CYCLES}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
held AS (
  -- forward sample-and-hold over every history row (the last row and a gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS hold nothing)
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    LEAD(epoch_s) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY epoch_s) - epoch_s AS dt_seconds
  FROM h
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    hd.equipment_id,
    hd.timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN j.equipment_id IS NULL THEN 0.0
      WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 0 THEN 0.0
      WHEN hd.dt_seconds IS NULL OR hd.dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR hd.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 0.0
      ELSE hd.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    COALESCE(j.raw_fault, 0) AS confirmed,
    CASE WHEN j.coarse_h = 1 AND j.raw_fault = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS floor_fault
  FROM held hd
  LEFT JOIN judged j
    ON j.equipment_id = hd.equipment_id AND j.timestamp_utc = hd.timestamp_utc
)
SELECT
  p.equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(a.fault_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(a.covered_s / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 OR COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(100.0 * a.fault_s / a.covered_s AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS fault_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN p.proof_kind = 0 THEN 'no_run_status'
    WHEN COALESCE(a.covered_s, 0.0) <= 0.0 THEN 'insufficient_trend'
    WHEN a.floor_fault = 1 THEN 'coarse_floor'
    ELSE 'assessed'
  END AS assessment
FROM pick p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS fault_s,
    SUM(held_seconds) AS covered_s,
    MAX(CASE WHEN floor_fault = 1 AND held_seconds > 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS floor_fault
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id
) a ON a.equipment_id = p.equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- xs_mix.sql — Cross-sensor consistency (#1780): mixed-air temperature outside the outdoor / return mixing envelope.
-- A sensor or mapping finding, not an economizer fault: with the fan proven on, mixed_air_temperature must lie in
--   [min(outdoor_air_intake_temperature, return_air_temperature) - MIX_BAND, max(outdoor_air_intake_temperature, return_air_temperature) + MIX_BAND]
-- at any damper position (closed: mixed_air_temperature ~ return_air_temperature, open: mixed_air_temperature ~ outdoor_air_intake_temperature). Fan on: supply_fan_operating_status, else supply_fan_command, else the run proof.
-- No sample with mixed_air_temperature, outdoor_air_intake_temperature and return_air_temperature together -> assessment 'no_temperatures'; no run proof bound (gate on) ->
-- 'no_run_proof'. Not assessed: fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass). Run-proof gated (#1608).
WITH rp AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COUNT(operating_status) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_run_proof
  FROM history
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
h AS (
  SELECT
    operating_status,
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mixed_air_temperature,
    CASE WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature < return_air_temperature THEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature ELSE return_air_temperature END AS env_lo,
    CASE WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature IS NULL OR return_air_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature > return_air_temperature THEN outdoor_air_intake_temperature ELSE return_air_temperature END AS env_hi,
    CASE
      WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > {{FAN_ON_MIN}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
inputs AS (
  SELECT h.equipment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND h.env_lo IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'no_temperatures'
      WHEN MAX(rp.no_run_proof) = 1 THEN 'no_run_proof'
      ELSE 'assessed'
    END AS assessment
  FROM h
  JOIN rp ON rp.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
  GROUP BY h.equipment_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    i.assessment,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} >= 0.5 AND COALESCE(operating_status, 0) <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN h.fan_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature IS NULL OR h.env_lo IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature < h.env_lo - {{MIX_BAND}} THEN 1
      WHEN h.mixed_air_temperature > h.env_hi + {{MIX_BAND}} THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    -- #1631: proven-on (the run-proof gate passes) time is the fault_pct denominator (active_hours)
    CASE WHEN {{REQUIRE_RUN_PROOF}} < 0.5 THEN 1 WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS proof_active
  FROM h
  JOIN inputs i ON i.equipment_id = h.equipment_id
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    proof_active,
    assessment,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed'
       THEN SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed' THEN SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed'
       THEN SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS active_hours,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed'
       THEN COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
                     / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN proof_active = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0), 0.0)
       ELSE NULL END AS fault_pct,
  MAX(assessment) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- xs_copy.sql — Cross-sensor consistency (#1780): two temperature roles of one unit carry the same (copied) signal.
-- Pairs: return_air_temperature/discharge_air_temperature, mixed_air_temperature/discharge_air_temperature, mixed_air_temperature/return_air_temperature, zone_air_temperature/discharge_air_temperature, zone_air_temperature/terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature. A pair matches at a sample when both are bound
-- and |a - b| <= COPY_TOL. A run of consecutive matching samples is a copy when the first role moves by at least
-- CHANGE_MIN over the run (max - min): two flat series that agree are a flatline (SV-FLATLINE), not a copy.
-- Fault: any pair in a copy run, held for CONFIRM_SECONDS (hours, not a few samples). Both roles are named; blame is
-- not assigned. No pair with both roles on any sample -> assessment 'no_pair': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    return_air_temperature, mixed_air_temperature, zone_air_temperature,
    CASE WHEN return_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(return_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature) <= {{COPY_TOL}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m1,
    CASE WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(mixed_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature) <= {{COPY_TOL}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m2,
    CASE WHEN mixed_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND return_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(mixed_air_temperature - return_air_temperature) <= {{COPY_TOL}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m3,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ABS(zone_air_temperature - discharge_air_temperature) <= {{COPY_TOL}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m4,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature IS NOT NULL
         THEN CASE WHEN ABS(zone_air_temperature - terminal_unit_discharge_air_temperature) <= {{COPY_TOL}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS m5
  FROM history
),
inputs AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(m1) + COUNT(m2) + COUNT(m3) + COUNT(m4) + COUNT(m5) = 0 THEN 'no_pair' ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM m
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
edges AS (
  -- a new run starts wherever the match flag changes (a missing pair is not a match)
  SELECT m.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(m1, 0) = COALESCE(LAG(m1) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n1,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(m2, 0) = COALESCE(LAG(m2) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n2,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(m3, 0) = COALESCE(LAG(m3) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n3,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(m4, 0) = COALESCE(LAG(m4) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n4,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(m5, 0) = COALESCE(LAG(m5) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n5
  FROM m
),
runs AS (
  SELECT edges.*,
    SUM(n1) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS r1,
    SUM(n2) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS r2,
    SUM(n3) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS r3,
    SUM(n4) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS r4,
    SUM(n5) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS r5
  FROM edges

    MAX(mixed_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r2) - MIN(mixed_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r2) AS s2,
    MAX(mixed_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r3) - MIN(mixed_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r3) AS s3,

    MAX(zone_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r5) - MIN(zone_air_temperature) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, r5) AS s5

      WHEN s.m3 = 1 AND s.s3 >= {{CHANGE_MIN}} THEN 1

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- xs_clip.sql — Cross-sensor consistency (#1780): a transmitter clipped at a round full scale (an instrumentation
-- finding, not a range fault: the value may be inside the SV-RANGE bounds).
-- Roles and their round step (SI): zone_air_co2 (CO2_ROUND ppm), discharge_air_static_pressure (STATIC_ROUND Pa), discharge_air_volume_flow_rate (FLOW_ROUND L/s).
-- discharge_air_static_pressure and discharge_air_volume_flow_rate count only fan-on samples (supply_fan_operating_status, else supply_fan_command, else operating_status, else every sample).
-- A role is clipped when its highest counted value is a positive multiple of its round step, at least CLIP_SHARE
-- percent of its counted samples sit at that value (within 1e-6; CLIP_SHARE is 0-100, QUDT PERCENT), and the series
-- is not flat (some sample is lower). A design maximum
-- that is not round, or reached once, is not clipped.
-- Fault: a counted sample of a clipped role at the clip value, held for CONFIRM_SECONDS. No role with data ->
-- assessment 'no_clip_role': fault_hours NULL, covered_hours 0 (never a silent pass).
WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_air_co2 AS v1,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > {{FAN_ON_MIN}} THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_static_pressure END
         ELSE discharge_air_static_pressure END AS v2,
    CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN supply_fan_command IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN supply_fan_command > {{FAN_ON_MIN}} THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         WHEN operating_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN operating_status > 0.05 THEN discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END
         ELSE discharge_air_volume_flow_rate END AS v3,
    CASE WHEN zone_air_co2 IS NULL AND discharge_air_static_pressure IS NULL AND discharge_air_volume_flow_rate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_role
  FROM history
),
tops AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(v1) AS t1, MIN(v1) AS l1, COUNT(v1) AS c1,
    MAX(v2) AS t2, MIN(v2) AS l2, COUNT(v2) AS c2,
    MAX(v3) AS t3, MIN(v3) AS l3, COUNT(v3) AS c3,
    CASE WHEN SUM(has_role) = 0 THEN 'no_clip_role' ELSE 'assessed' END AS assessment
  FROM v
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
at_top AS (
  SELECT v.equipment_id, v.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN v.v1 IS NOT NULL AND v.v1 >= t.t1 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a1,
    CASE WHEN v.v2 IS NOT NULL AND v.v2 >= t.t2 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a2,
    CASE WHEN v.v3 IS NOT NULL AND v.v3 >= t.t3 - 0.000001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a3
  FROM v
  JOIN tops t ON t.equipment_id = v.equipment_id
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT t.equipment_id, t.assessment,
    CASE WHEN t.t1 > 0 AND t.l1 < t.t1 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t1 - {{CO2_ROUND}} * ROUND(t.t1 / {{CO2_ROUND}})) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a1) >= {{CLIP_SHARE}} * t.c1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k1,
    CASE WHEN t.t2 > 0 AND t.l2 < t.t2 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t2 - {{STATIC_ROUND}} * ROUND(t.t2 / {{STATIC_ROUND}})) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a2) >= {{CLIP_SHARE}} * t.c2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k2,
    CASE WHEN t.t3 > 0 AND t.l3 < t.t3 - 0.000001
          AND ABS(t.t3 - {{FLOW_ROUND}} * ROUND(t.t3 / {{FLOW_ROUND}})) <= 0.000001
          AND 100.0 * SUM(a.a3) >= {{CLIP_SHARE}} * t.c3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k3
  FROM tops t
  JOIN at_top a ON a.equipment_id = t.equipment_id
  GROUP BY t.equipment_id, t.assessment, t.t1, t.l1, t.c1, t.t2, t.l2, t.c2, t.t3, t.l3, t.c3
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.equipment_id,
    a.timestamp_utc,
    k.assessment,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN k.k1 = 1 AND a.a1 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN k.k2 = 1 AND a.a2 = 1 THEN 1
      WHEN k.k3 = 1 AND a.a3 = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM at_top a
  JOIN clipped k ON k.equipment_id = a.equipment_id
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > ({{MAX_GAP_HOURS}} * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    assessment,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= {{CONFIRM_SECONDS}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed'
       THEN SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 ELSE NULL END AS fault_hours,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed' THEN SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS covered_hours,
  CASE WHEN MAX(assessment) = 'assessed'
       THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0)
       ELSE NULL END AS fault_pct,
  MAX(assessment) AS assessment
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
